blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evaluation for automatic crisis reporting should measure what practitioners need, not what is convenient to compare. Through LLM-assisted, author-approved content analysis, we derive a 15-slot information schema from professional humanitarian situation reports using qualitative content analysis, then evaluate 121 human and 261 LLM-generated reports across five disasters and three hazard types. Under google/gemini-3.7-flash on Cyclone Idai, the best machine arm is nominally above the empirical human ceiling (0.827 vs. 0.821), but the difference is statistically indistinguishable from zero (95\% bootstrap CI $[-.049,.059]$; permutation $p=.852$), and the ordering does not replicate under openai/gpt-5.6-luna. On a blind 100-item Idai sample, the author agrees with the Gemini judge at 0.910 accuracy and unweighted Cohen's $κ=.799$. All four judges clear the plan's raw-agreement criterion of .7; only Gemini reaches .7 on chance-corrected $κ$. Across the three primary events, machine reports reproduce 5.4-11.0% of same-day official figures. Across those same events, raw exact-number matching links 14.3-19.6% of official figures and 85.4-90.1% of machine figures to the social stream; manual audit confirms 45/50 declared absences, 4/25 official matches, and 24/25 machine matches semantically. The issuing-provenance gap is positive in all 12 observed event-judge cells: report date, organisation, series, and authority were not supplied at professional-report coverage in any cell. On the three primary events, ROUGE-L is uninformative, BERTScore is negatively associated with completeness after multiplicity correction, and a generic LLM judge changes sign.
blocks.zh: 自动危机报告评价应衡量从业人员需要什么,而不是比较什么。 通过LLM协助、作者批准的内容分析,我们利用质量内容分析,从专业人道主义局势报告中得出一个15分块信息计划,然后评价121个人类报告和261个LLM生成的报告,涉及5个灾害和3个危险类型。 在 " Idai " 气旋上的google/gemini-3.7-flash下,最好的机器臂名义上高于经验性的人类上限(0.827对0.821),但从统计学上看,这种区别与零(95-X靴子CI $[-049.059]美元;通量=852美元)是无法区分的;在Openai/gpt-5.6-luna下,订单不会重复。 在盲目100个项目Idai样本中,提交人同意双子座法官的意见,准确性为0.910,未加权的Cohen为799美元。 4名法官都同意该计划的原始协议标准为7;只有双子公司在概率补偿的美元中达到7分。 在三个主要活动中,机器报告转载了5.4%至11.0%的同日官方数字。 在这些事件中,原始准确数字与官方数字的14.3%-19.6%和机器数字的85.4%-90.1%与社会流相匹配;人工审计确认45%/50人宣布缺席,4/25人正式匹配,24/25人机器完全匹配。 在所观察到的所有12个事件判断单元中,签发与证明之间的差距是积极的:报告日期、组织、系列和权威没有在任何单元的专业报告覆盖范围内提供。 在三个主要事件中,ROUGE-L是无信息化的,BERTScore在经过多重修正后与完整性有负关系,一个通用LLM法官会改变标志.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A situation report (sitrep) is not simply a summary. It is a dated, attributed operational document that supports the coordination of a response by reporting current needs, actions, gaps, and key figures ( United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, 2023 ) . The distinction matters for the humanitarian teams who would act on such reports and for the LT4CPR shared task ( LT4CPR Shared Task Organisers, 2026 ) : a fluent report can mention every expected topic while omitting the quantitative and provenance-bearing information on which operational use depends.
blocks.zh: 情况报告(sitrep)不仅仅是一个摘要。 这是一份日期已过的业务文件,通过报告当前的需要、行动、差距和关键人物来支持协调应对措施(联合国人道主义事务协调厅,2023年)。 就这些报告采取行动的人道主义小组和LT4CPR分担的任务(LT4CPR共享任务组织者,2026年)的区别问题: 一份流利的报告可以提及每一个预期专题,而忽略了业务用途所依赖的量化和来源信息。

blocks.en: Most automatic evaluation begins with available instruments: overlap with a reference, embedding similarity, or a general-purpose model asked whether an output is good. We instead begin with practice. We ask what information professional humanitarian organisations actually place in sitreps, how much of it a system can recover from social media, and whether common metrics recognise that recovery.
blocks.zh: 大多数自动评价从现有的仪器开始:与参考重叠、嵌入相似性或通用模型问产出是否良好。 我们从实践开始。 我们询问,专业人道主义组织实际上在Sitrep中设置了哪些信息,一个系统能从社交媒体中恢复多少信息,共同的衡量标准是否承认这种恢复。

blocks.en: We make three contributions. First, we induce a 15-slot schema from professional reports through LLM-assisted qualitative content analysis, and report what each computational step contributed and what it excluded. Second, we define operational completeness relative to an empirical human ceiling and locate a visibility ceiling : information that is present in official reports but absent from the source stream. Third, we meta-evaluate ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and a generic LLM judge against operational completeness. The apparent paradox is the paper’s central result: machine sitreps look complete by slot presence, but their quantitative picture is bounded by an input stream containing only a small fraction of the official record. We close with implications for humanitarian practice (Section 7 ) and for shared-task evaluation (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,我们通过LLM协助的定性内容分析,从专业报告中引入一个15分点的计划,并报告每个计算步骤的贡献和排除的内容。 第二,我们界定了与实证人上限相比的业务完整性,并确定了能见度上限:正式报告载有但来源流中没有的信息。 第三,我们对ROUGE-L、BERTSCore和一个通用LLM法官的操作完整性进行了元评价。 明显的悖论是纸的中心结果:机器的sitrep 由位点存在来看是完整的,但其数量图则以只包含官方记录一小部分的输入流为界. 我们最后谈到人道主义做法(第7节)和共同任务评价(第8节)的影响。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Crisis informatics has long treated social media as a rapid source for situational awareness, while also documenting its noise, brevity, and uneven coverage ( Imran et al., 2016 ; Alam et al., 2021 ) . Recent work surveys the resulting language-technology ecosystem and its operational challenges ( Lewis et al., 2025 ) . Our question differs from message classification: we compare a generated operational product against reporting practice and explicitly measure what the input medium did not supply in this corpus.
blocks.zh: 危机信息学长期将社交媒体视为快速了解情况的来源,同时也记录了其噪音,简洁,报道不均(Imran等人,2016年;Alam等人,2021年). 最近的工作调查了由此产生的语言技术生态系统及其运作挑战(Lewis等人,2025年)。 我们的问题与信息分类不同:我们比较了产生的业务产品与报告做法,并明确衡量输入介质中未提供的内容。

blocks.en: Crisis summarisation is the nearest task family. CrisisLTLSum extracts and abstractively summarises 1,000 local Twitter timelines ( Rajaby Faghihi et al., 2022 ) ; CrisisFACTS produces event-day timelines from social and news streams and evaluates pooled facts for comprehensiveness and redundancy ( Buntain et al., 2023 ) ; prompt-based LLM systems have also aggregated geolocated social feedback into disaster reports ( Cantini et al., 2025 ) . The current LT4CPR task maps crisis posts to a structured official template ( LT4CPR Shared Task Organisers, 2026 ) .We add a combination these benchmarks do not provide: a slot-level comparison of model reports with independently published humanitarian sitreps, a practice-derived schema, and an audit of which official information was visible in the input. CrisisFACTS’s earlier events used official ICS-209 incident forms as an alternative ground truth ( Buntain et al., 2023 ) , but without a practice-derived schema or an input-visibility audit.
blocks.zh: 危机汇总是最近的家庭任务。 CrisisLTLSum摘录并抽象地总结了1 000个当地推特时间表(Rajaby Faghihi等人,2022年);CrisesFACTS从社会和新闻流中生成活动日时间表,并评价综合事实,以全面性和冗余性(Buntain等人,2023年);基于快速的LLM系统也将地理分布的社会反馈汇总到灾害报告中(Cantini等人,2025年)。 目前的LT4CPR任务将危机帖子映射到结构化的官方模板(LT4CPR共享任务组织者,2026年). 我们补充一个组合,这些基准没有规定:将示范报告与独立公布的人道主义汇编进行时间档级的比较,根据实践制定的计划,以及在投入中可以看到官方资料的审计。 CrisisFACTS早先的事件使用官方的ICS-209事件表作为替代的地面真相(Buntain等人,2023年),但没有实践衍生的策略或输入-可见性审计.

blocks.en: Our schema also differs from NLP event-schema induction, which learns entity and event-role structures from corpora ( Chambers, 2013 ) , and from methods that optimise prompt tokens for a downstream objective ( Shin et al., 2020 ) . It is an LLM-assisted, author-approved content-analysis description of recurrent document information types. Operational completeness inherits the content-unit intuition of Pyramid and later Summary Content Unit evaluation ( Nenkova and Passonneau, 2004 ; Nawrath et al., 2024 ) , but its units are practice expectations induced across reports, its categories allow partial credit, and its reference point is an empirical human ceiling.
blocks.zh: 我们的计划也不同于NLP事件-schema诱导,它从公司(Chambers,2013年)学习实体和事件-作用结构,也不同于优化下游目标快速信号的方法(Shin等人,2020年)。 它是由LLM协助、作者核准的对经常性文件信息类型的内容分析描述。 业务完整性继承了金字塔和后来的简要内容股评价的内容-单位直觉(Nenkova and Passonneau,2004年;Nawrath等人,2024年),但其单位是不同报告之间产生的做法预期,其类别允许部分功劳,其参考点是一个经验性的人类上限.

blocks.en: Summarisation evaluation commonly uses lexical overlap such as ROUGE ( Lin, 2004 ) and contextual similarity such as BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) . Prior analyses show that such metrics can track topical similarity rather than information quality and that realistic system-level ROUGE correlations may approach zero ( Deutsch and Roth, 2021 ; Deutsch et al., 2022 ) . The latter critique is system-level, whereas our main Table 3 correlations are between reports; we therefore also report a descriptive ordering of the four generator–prompt arms. LLM judges offer flexible reference-free evaluation ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , but can favour their own generations ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . We test all three metric families against a domain-derived criterion rather than general ratings.
blocks.zh: 总结评价通常使用ROUGE(Lin,2004年)等词汇重叠,BERTScore(Zhang等人,2020年)等背景相似性. 先前的分析表明,这种衡量标准可以跟踪专题相似性而不是信息质量,现实的系统级ROUGE关联性可能接近零(Deutsch and Roth, 2021;Deutsch等人, 2022年)。 后一种批评是系统层面的,而我们的主要表3是报告之间的关联;因此,我们还报告对四个生成器-即时武器进行描述性排序。 LLM评委提供灵活的无参考评价(Liu等人,2023年),但可以有利于自己的几代人(Panickssery等人,2024年). 我们对照一个域生成的标准而不是一般的评级来测试所有三个度量家族.

We derive UTC dates from identifier snowflakes, bucket posts by event-day, and generate on days with at least 30 posts (for Kerala, only the first five such days, to stay within our cost limit); each generation reads a seed-17 sample of at most 400 of that day’s posts, stratified by HumAID label, while source availability is measured against the complete day. We cross api-strong = deepseek-v4-pro and api-fast = deepseek-v4-flash with generic and schema-guided prompts. Calls ran 30–31 August 2026 UTC. The public aliases were then the Pro GA update dated 13 August and the Flash-0731 update dated 31 July; DeepSeek exposed no immutable snapshot suffix ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) . The schema-guided prompt supplies the 15 slot names and definitions and asks for the names as section headings. Two empty Idai generations and one empty Maria generation are excluded from every judge and metric. Social-media text is neither redistributed nor quoted in this paper.

blocks.en: 4 Inducing a Practice-Derived Schema
blocks.zh: 4 引导实践实践的Schema

blocks.en: We borrow the phases of inductive content analysis—preparing material, organising codes into categories, and reporting an auditable structure ( Elo and Kyngäs, 2008 ; Krippendorff, 2018 ) —but a model, not the researcher, did the open coding. Qualitative researchers interviewed by Schroeder et al. (2025) worried that model-led coding imposes the model’s interpretations and changes what researchers notice; Schroeder et al. recommend validating each LLM task, for example against human coding, as Wang et al. (2025) did by comparing LLM-generated codes and themes with a prior human analysis of the same data. We have no human coding of our reports to compare against. We therefore separate computation that organised material (embedding and clustering near-synonymous codes) from steps that structured the conceptual space: our coding instructions and the model’s codes set the vocabulary, a 25-cluster cap chose what reached review, and model-written definitions and an AI-drafted merge, which the author approved, set category boundaries. We treat the schema as one defensible description of Idai reporting practice, not the only one.
blocks.zh: 我们借用了诱导性内容分析的阶段——准备材料,将代码组织成类别,并报告可审计的结构(Elo and Kyngäs, 2008;Krippendorff, 2018)——但是一个模型,而不是研究者,做了开放的编码. Schroeder等人(2025年)接受采访的定性研究者担心模型引导的编码会强制要求模型的解释,并改变研究人员注意到的;Schroeder等人建议验证每一项LLM任务,例如针对人类编码,如Wang等人(2025年)将LLM生成的代码和主题与之前对同一数据的人类分析进行比较. 我们的报告没有人类编码可以比较。 因此,我们将有组织的材料(编组和集群近似同义代码)与构建概念空间的步骤分开:我们的编码指令和模型的代码设置了词汇,一个25个集群的上限选择了到达审查的内容,一个模型写的定义和一个AI起草的合并,作者批准了这个定义,设定了类别界限。 我们把这一计划看作是对伊代报告做法的一个合理描述,而不是唯一的描述。

blocks.en: The induction set is all 56 evaluated Idai reports (OCHA 44, IFRC 4, UNICEF 3, WFP 2, WHO 2, IOM 1): a sampler stratified by organisation and response phase (thirds of the collection’s date range) requested 60, so every available report was included, and most are early-response products (45 early, eight middle, two late, one undated when sampled). deepseek-v4-pro open-coded each report in a separate call, instructed to record only information types present in it, each with an internal evidence span and location. The instructions also named five reporting conventions to record (attribution, as-of dates, hedged figures, revision language, and figures with sources) and gave four example code names, three of which (casualty figures, access constraints, funding-appeal status) became the most frequent code names of three candidates, along with four example section headings for locating codes. The conventions and example names echo our project plan, so these categories’ prominence reflects our instructions as well as the reports. Reports longer than 30,000 characters (12 of 56, including all four from IFRC) were coded from their first 24,000 and last 6,000 characters, so 13% of the induction text was never coded. The pass produced 1,360 codes; evidence spans remain in the private audit trail and are not reproduced here.
blocks.zh: 这套简介是所有56份经过评价的IDAI报告(人道协调厅44、红十字与红新月联会4、儿童基金会3、粮食计划署2、卫生组织2、移徙组织1): 按组织和反应阶段(收集日期范围的三分之一)分级的取样员要求60份,因此列入了每份现有报告,大多数是早期反应产品(早期45份、中期8份、迟到2份、抽样时未注明日期)。 deepseek-v4-pro open-code each report in a 单独调用,指令只记录其中存在的信息类型,每个报告都有内部证据跨度和位置. 该指示还指定了五个报告公约来记录(归属、日期、被套期数字、修订语言和有来源的数字),并提供了四个实例代号,其中三个(伤亡数字、访问限制、供资-上诉状况)成为三个候选人最常见的代号,以及四个查找代号的示例部分标题。 公约和实例名称与我们的项目计划相呼应,因此,这些类别的重要性反映了我们的指示和报告。 报道中超过3万个字符(56个中的12个,包括来自红十字与红新月联会的4个)是从前24000个字符和最后6000个字符中编码的,因此13%的感应文本从未编码过. 通行证产生了1 360个代码;证据跨度仍留在私人审计线索中,此处不转载。

blocks.en: We embedded code names and definitions with MiniLM sentence embeddings and clustered them (average linkage, cosine distance, threshold .35), yielding 382 clusters. Clusters were ranked by the number of reports they covered, then by code count and name, and the top 25 became candidate slots, each named, defined, and given two synthetic examples by deepseek-v4-pro . The other 357 clusters, holding 780 of the 1,360 codes (57%), never reached review. Most occur in a single report (209 clusters) or fragment concepts that the final slots cover. But ranking each cluster by its own report count also penalised concepts that the coder named inconsistently across separately coded reports, a redundancy Wang et al. (2025) also observed: protection and the hedging of unconfirmed figures were split across several smaller clusters, and the largest logistics cluster, like a revision-language cluster, reached 12 reports but lost an alphabetical tie-break with the last two candidates. The sector-needs, sector-response, and access slots can absorb some logistics and protection content, but no slot records hedging.

blocks.en: The author reviewed every candidate, merged overlapping concepts, renamed categories, rewrote definitions, and supplied two synthetic examples per slot. The frozen schema records the approver and approval time. The audit trail retains sampled report identifiers, per-report codes, and consolidation decisions. The final slots are: data currency and report metadata; sourcing and attribution; casualties and affected population; displacement and accommodation sites; health, disease outbreak and nutrition; physical, economic and agricultural damage; funding and donor contributions; education; WASH; food security and assistance; access constraints; coordination arrangements; sector needs and gaps; sector response actions; and shelter and non-food items.

A matched heading with an empty or explicitly no-information body is capped at absent ; a non-negated body with fewer than eight alphabetic tokens is capped at partial ; other scores are unchanged.

blocks.en: For human validation, a seed-17 slot-stratified Idai sample contains 100 unique document–slot items, balanced between professional and machine reports and spanning all 15 slots. The author applied the same three-category rubric while blind to the withheld verdicts of all four Idai judges. For each judge, we report exact-match accuracy, unweighted nominal Cohen’s κ \kappa , and linear-weighted κ \kappa as an ordinal sensitivity check; for primary Gemini we additionally report one-vs-rest precision, recall, and F1 for each label, treating the human label as ground truth. A missing model verdict is dropped only for that judge and reduces its stated denominator. Our project plan, written before annotation, set the acceptance rule as judge agreement ≥ .7 \geq.7 on a 100-item hand-scored sample without naming the statistic; our pre-annotation scoring code applied it to raw agreement, but some pre-annotation notes restated it as Cohen’s κ ≥ .7 \kappa\geq.7 , so we report both. blocks.en: A regex extractor identifies numeric values in machine reports, same-day human reports, and the complete same-day social stream. Figure precision is the share of machine values also in the human report; recall reverses the denominator; casualty recall restricts the comparison to deaths, injuries, and missing people. A source-availability test asks both whether machine figures are traceable to the stream and whether official figures occur anywhere in that stream. Official-in-stream is averaged over unique valid event-days because its value repeats across machine arms; other cells average valid same-day machine–official pairs. Undefined denominators are dropped. Percentile 95% CIs use 10,000 seed-17 resamples of event-days for official-in-stream and pairs for the other cells. A seed-17 manual audit samples 50 official figures marked stream-absent plus 25 official–stream and 25 machine–stream exact matches; two-sided Clopper–Pearson intervals bound each error rate. This analysis contains no model judge.

blocks.en: We score each non-empty machine report against same-day or nearest same-window human references using ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and a schema-blind LLM quality score produced by google/gemini-3.7-flash , the same model used as the Gemini slot judge. Meta-evaluation includes only the three primary events, Idai, Irma, and Maria, because each has a substantial reference corpus; Puebla and Kerala each have only eight same-day pairs and weaker or genre-contaminated references. We compute per-event Spearman correlations with operational completeness. Reported p p -values are SciPy 1.18’s two-sided asymptotic spearmanr values; Table 3 applies Holm–Bonferroni correction jointly across its nine tests. The quality judge sees only a request to rate usefulness, clarity, organisation, and credibility on a 1–10 scale. Appendix A specifies the exact implementations and prompts.

blocks.en: The result separates medium-driven from event-driven gaps. blocks.en: Table 2 resolves the paradox without a model in the loop, while also exposing the regex’s limits. Across Idai, Irma, and Maria, exact-number recall is 11.0%, 5.4%, and 8.9%; casualty recall is 33.0%, 52.1%, and 12.5%. Raw matching links 14.3–19.6% of official figures and 85.4–90.1% of machine figures to the stream. Manual review confirms 45/50 declared official absences, but only 4/25 official matches are semantic, versus 24/25 machine matches. Thus the official column is an ungated exact-match rate, inflated by common-number collisions, while sampled machine traceability is substantially more reliable. Puebla and Kerala are not averaged into the headline: each has only eight same-day pairs, Puebla’s references are figure-sparse short products, and Kerala has the densest stream in the corpus.

blocks.en: 7 Implications for Humanitarian Practice
blocks.zh: 对人道主义实践的影响

blocks.en: We ran no deployment or practitioner study, and our drafts came from two DeepSeek models reading English-language posts, so what follows is what the measurements imply for that setting, not an observed effect; nor did we measure whether drafts add value by arriving before official reports.
blocks.zh: 我们没有进行部署或从业者研究,我们的草稿来自阅读英文文章的两个DeepSeek模型,因此,下面是衡量这种设置意味着什么,而不是一种观察到的效果;我们也没有通过在正式报告之前到达来衡量草稿是否增加价值。

blocks.en: On Idai, under our best-validated judge, drafts prompted with the schema covered it about as fully as professional reports (Figure 2 ), although truncating long professional reports for judging understates their coverage. Their figures and provenance were the weak point: on Idai, Irma, and Maria, exact matching linked only 5–11% of same-day official figures to them (Table 2 ), and on every event they stated their own as-of date, issuing organisation, and update number less often than professional reports. A draft can therefore look finished without being sourced: reviewers should check its figures, dates, and sources, not its headings. It is best treated as an unverified situational signal whose figures need re-sourcing from official or assessment channels and whose provenance must come from the issuing office; it should not circulate under an agency’s name. Because generations can repeat phone numbers and email addresses from crisis posts (Appendix A ), drafts also need screening for personal data.
blocks.zh: 在Idai, 在我们最有说服力的法官看来, 他们的数字和来源是弱点:在Idai、Irma和Maria身上,精确的比对只把5-11%的同一天的官方数字与他们联系起来(表2),在每一事件上,他们都表示他们自己的日期,发布组织,更新的数字比专业报告要少。 因此,草案可以看成没有来源:审查者应检查其数字、日期和来源,而不是其标题。 最好将其视为一个未经核实的情况信号,其数字需要从官方或评估渠道重新来源,其来源必须来自发行部门;它不应以机构的名义流通。 由于世代可以重复危机帖(Appendix A)的电话号码和电子邮件地址,草稿还需要筛选个人数据.

blocks.en: Similarity to professional reports and generic LLM quality ratings did not track completeness here (Table 3 ). Pilots and procurement can instead test a tool on past emergencies: check its figures against same-day official reports, compare it with professional reports of the same type rather than with a perfect score, and ask which inputs it used (Section 8 ).
blocks.zh: 与专业报告和通用LLM质量评级的相似之处没有在此跟踪完整性(表3)。 相反,试点和采购可以测试一个有关过去紧急情况的工具:对照同一天的正式报告检查其数字,将其与同类型的专业报告进行比较,而不是以完美的分数比较,并询问所使用的投入(第8节)。

blocks.en: Most official figures never appeared in the day’s HumAID posts, a labelled sample of English-language tweets, so a stronger model could not have recovered them from that input. Drafting is therefore likely to be more useful when connected to the channels official figures come from, with social media flagging emerging needs and locations for verification; we did not test this. Gaps also vary by event: drafts covered displacement much less often than professional reports on Idai, but not on Irma or Maria, so a gap seen in one emergency needs re-checking in the next.
blocks.zh: 多数官方人物从未出现在当天的HumAID文章中, 因此,如果将起草工作与官方数字的渠道联系起来,而社交媒体则标出新出现的需求和核实地点,则起草工作可能更加有用;我们没有检验这一点。 差距也因事件而异:草案涉及流离失所的频率远低于关于Idai的专业报告,但没有关于Irma或Maria的专业报告,因此,在下一个紧急情况下需要重新检查一个差距。

blocks.en: Professional reports also scored below 1.0 (Table 5 ), partly because shorter products such as snapshots and infographics are not meant to cover every slot. A practitioner-reviewed slot list, adapted to each product type and extended with categories ours lacks or only partly covers, such as protection, could help authors check for unintended omissions; whether that improves operational use needs evaluation with practitioners.
blocks.zh: 专业报告也得分低于1.0(表5),部分原因是短小的产品,如快照和图象,并不是要覆盖每个插槽。 一份经从业人员审查的槽清单,根据每种产品类型加以调整,并按我们缺少或仅部分涵盖的类别加以扩展,例如保护,可以帮助作者检查是否有意外遗漏;这是否有助于改进对从业人员的业务使用评价。

blocks.en: As of 31 August 2026, the official LT4CPR guidelines score report sections 3–11 using text similarity, bullet-level alignment, and confidence-label agreement, then average replicates within windows, windows within crises, and crises; the public task page also named ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore as anticipated automatic metrics. The official results, released since, rank systems by the mean of BERTScore F1 and BLEURT ( LT4CPR Shared Task Organisers, 2026 ) ; because BERTScore was negatively associated with completeness on all three primary events (Table 3 ), that ranking need not track operational completeness, although we did not test BLEURT or the task’s own reference reports. The results suggest seven explicit deltas to that protocol rather than another single metric.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Professional reporting practice reveals a sharp distinction between looking complete and being operationally grounded. Under one judge, an LLM arm is nominally above but statistically indistinguishable from the empirical human ceiling; the ordering does not replicate under Luna and is smaller than the truncation bias measured among sampled affected reports. Across the measured primary events, systems reproduced little of the official quantitative record, and across all 12 observed event–judge cells they supplied issuing provenance less often than professionals. Crisis-report evaluation must measure source availability, figure grounding, and judge-indexed human-relative completeness together. For practitioners, a draft built from social media largely restates figures already in that day’s posts; it cannot stand in for the official record or carry an agency’s authority.
blocks.zh: 专业报告做法显示,在看齐和有业务依据之间有明显的区别。 在一名法官之下,LLM臂在名义上高于但从统计学上与经验的人类上限是无法区分的;订单不会在月下复制,而且小于抽样受影响报告中测量的截断偏差。 在所衡量的主要事件中,系统只复制了很少的官方数量记录,在所观察到的所有12个事件中,法官小组提供的发行来源比专业人员少。 危机报告评价必须共同衡量来源的可得性、数字基础和与人有关的法官索引完整性。 对执行人员来说,由社交媒体制作的草稿基本上重述了当日的帖子中已经出现的数字;它不能作为官方记录或具有机构的权威。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The blind validation in Table 4 uses one annotator, who also approved the schema, and only Idai; it may therefore overstate agreement with independent practitioners and does not validate transfer to other events. All four judges reach the plan’s .7 threshold on raw agreement, but only Gemini reaches .7 on the separately reported chance-corrected κ \kappa . On unique document–slot complete cases, unweighted nominal Fleiss’ κ \kappa between Luna and Gemini is 0.653 ( n = 2,351 n=2{,}351 ), 0.646 ( n = 1,005 n=1{,}005 ), and 0.707 ( n = 1,020 n=1{,}020 ) on Idai, Irma, and Maria. These values lie outside the acceptance rule and measure consistency, not correctness; Qwen’s missingness is non-random. All LLM-judged conclusions should therefore be read alongside the model-independent source-availability result.
blocks.zh: 表4中的盲目验证使用一名注释员,他也批准了这个计划,而只有Idai;因此,它可能与独立的执行人员达成过多的约定,并不验证向其他事件的转移. 所有四位法官都达到了该计划的7个原始协议门槛,但只有双子座达到7个单独报告的概率校正标准。 在独一无二的文档中,在Luna和双子座之间未加权的标称Fleiss的 $\kappa(n = 2,351 n = 2{,}351),0.646(n = 1,005 n = 1{,}005),在Idai,Irma,和Maria之间为0.707(n = 1,020 n = 1{,}020). 这些价值不在接受规则之外,并且衡量一致性,而不是正确性;Quen的缺失是非随意的. 因此,所有 LLM 判断的结论应与模型-独立源-可用性结果一并阅读。

blocks.en: The schema was induced from all 56 Idai reports, 44 of them OCHA’s, so it chiefly reflects OCHA reporting practice, and its Idai ceiling is in-sample; held-out professional reports on Irma and Maria score 0.71–0.76 (Table 5 ), below Idai’s 0.82–0.85. Its conceptual space was shaped before human review (Section 4 ): our instructions seeded five reporting conventions, one model proposed the codes from truncated text for the 12 longest reports, a 25-candidate cap left clusters holding 57% of the codes unreviewed, with drafted consolidation, capped in advance at 15 slots. The seeded provenance conventions are nonetheless pervasive in practice: an LLM-free lexicon released with our code counts 395 as-of date markers and 413 attribution phrases in the same reports. The model that proposed the codes and named the candidates, deepseek-v4-pro , is also the api-strong generator, whose schema-guided arm receives the slot names and definitions; slots shaped by its salience could favour its outputs. Completeness therefore describes the 15 measured slots, not all of reporting practice, and the omissions cut both ways: agency-reported categories such as protection and logistics would likely favour professional reports, whereas public-facing ones such as search and rescue or hazard forecasts could favour stream-derived drafts. No second researcher or practitioner independently coded the reports, so schema construction has no inter-coder reliability estimate; the released audit trail allows others to run that check. These limits bear on the completeness-based results (the inversion, the provenance gap, the human ceilings, and the metric correlations), not on figure grounding or source availability, which use neither the schema nor a model judge. HumAID and the generated reports are English-language, all drafts come from one generator family, and HumAID is itself a labelled sample of about 77K tweets drawn from about 24M ( Alam et al., 2021 ) , so the source ceiling describes this sample rather than social media at large; the ReliefWeb collection includes a small number of non-English products, limiting multilingual claims. Irma and Maria have 19 and 25 evaluated human reports, and Kerala has seven; their ceiling estimates are noisier than Idai’s. Puebla is genre-contaminated: 10 of 14 judged documents are infographics or snapshots, lowering its Luna collected-product score from 0.725 for sitreps alone to 0.567. We therefore treat Puebla and Kerala as supplementary.
blocks.zh: 计划是从所有56份Idai报告中引出的,其中44份是人道协调厅的报告,因此主要反映了人道协调厅的报告做法,其Idai的上限是模拟的;关于Irma和Maria的专业报告得分0.71-0.76(表5),低于Idai的0.82-0.85。 它的概念空间是在人类审查之前形成的(第4节):我们的指示以5项报告公约为基础,一个模式为12份最长的报告从短文中提出了代码,一个25个上限的左组,57%的代码未经审查,经过起草的合并,提前封顶在15个档位。 尽管如此,原始来源公约在实践中仍很普遍:用我们的代码发布的无LLM词典计有395个日期标记和413个归属短语。 提出代码并给候选人命名的模型,Deepseek-v4-pro,也是pip-strong的生成器,其计程导臂接收插槽名称和定义;其突出位置塑造的插槽可以有利于其输出. 因此,完整性描述的是15个测量档次,而不是所有报告做法,而遗漏则有两种方式:机构报告的类别,例如保护和后勤,可能有利于专业报告,而公共报告的类别,例如搜索和救援或灾害预报,则可能有利于流派产生的草案。 没有任何第二位研究人员或从业者独立地对报告进行编码,因此Schema building没有代码间可靠性估计;发布的审计线索允许其他人运行该检查. 这些限制涉及基于完整性的结果(反向、来源差距、人上限和衡量相关性),而不是基于数字或来源的可用性,这些结果既不使用计划,也不使用模型法官。 HumAID和生成的报告都是英语,所有的草稿都来自一个发电机家族,HumAID本身是大约从24M(Alam et al., 2021)中抽取的大约77K个推文的标注样本,所以源上限描述的是这个样本而不是一般社交媒体;ReliefWeb集包括少量非英语产品,限制了多语种的主张. Irma和Maria评估了19和25份人类报告,Kerala有7份;他们的上限估计比Idai的要高。 普埃布拉受到流派污染:14份判断文件中有10份是图象或快照,仅Sitrep就将其月球收集产品得分从0.725降至0.567. 因此,我们将普埃布拉和喀拉拉视为补充。

blocks.en: Regex figure matching can count coincidental numeric matches and miss semantically equivalent expressions. The manual audit quantifies both modes: 5/50 declared absences and 21/25 official exact matches were erroneous, while only 1/25 machine exact matches was erroneous. A machine figure absent from an official report is unverified, not necessarily false. Original judge inputs truncated reports after 20,000 characters; 56/100 evaluated primary-event professional reports exceeded that cap (30/56 Idai, 11/19 Irma, 15/25 Maria). We re-judged a seed-17 random sample of 12 affected reports (four per primary event) at full length with Gemini: the paired ceiling shift was +0.056 [+.031,+.081] (10,000 document-bootstrap draws). This quantifies bias among long reports, not the whole corpus, but is larger than the nominal Idai machine advantage. Presence also risks rubric leakage; our deterministic body gate lowered the nominal Gemini machine score from .827 to .824 but did not reverse it.
blocks.zh: Regex 数字匹配可以算出巧合的数值匹配,并错过模拟等效表达式. 人工审计对两种模式进行了量化:5/50的宣布缺席和21/25的官方准确匹配都是错误的,而只有1/25的机器准确匹配是错误的。 官方报告中没有的机器数字未经核实,不一定是虚假的。 原判法官在2万个字符后提供短篇报告;第56/100号评价的初级活动专业报告超过了这一上限(30/56 Idai,11/19 Irma,15/25 Maria)。 我们重新判断了种子-17随机抽样的12份受影响报告(每件主要事件4份),与双子座完全吻合:双子座的天花板变化为+0.056[+.031,+.081](10,000个文件-bootstrap图纸). 这量化了长篇报道中的偏差,不是全体的偏差,而是大于名义上的伊代机优势. 存在还有可能出现轻度渗漏;我们的确定体门将双子座机器的名义得分从0.827降至0.824,但没有逆转。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: ReliefWeb reports are public. Social-media text is not redistributed, no user identifiers appear, and no post is quoted verbatim.
blocks.zh: 救济网报道公开. 社交媒体文本没有重新分配,没有出现用户识别符,也没有逐字引用任何文章.

blocks.en: The system is intended as evaluation infrastructure, not an autonomous reporting tool. An operationally incomplete report that appears complete could misdirect scarce resources or falsely convey authority; the statistically unsupported nominal ordering still illustrates this deployment hazard.
blocks.zh: 该系统旨在作为评价基础设施,而不是一个自主的报告工具。 业务不完全的报告看来完整,可能误用稀少的资源或错误地传递权力;统计上无根据的名义命令仍然表明这种部署危险。

blocks.en: Appendix A Reproducibility and Audit Trail
blocks.zh: 附录A 可复制性和审计过程

blocks.en:
All LLM calls pass through one client with a disk cache, a fail-closed cost gate, and a JSONL log containing request hashes, token counts, costs, and lengths but never text. Seeds are fixed at 17. The recorded spend is $31.35, including $1.72 for the untruncated sensitivity run. The code and data release is available at https://github.com/techsachinkr/llm-sitrep-evaluation/ .
It includes supplementary/reproducibility/ : every prompt verbatim with sentinel payloads, the frozen 15-slot schema with definitions and two synthetic examples per slot, public model identifiers and call dates, the 125-report ReliefWeb manifest, and text-free matcher-audit labels with context hashes. The repository also releases the schema audit trail ( data/processed/schema/ ): the induction sample, every open code’s name and definition by report, all 382 clusters, the 25 candidates, and the merge rationales, without evidence spans. The manifest specifies first-20,000-Python-character truncation followed by [...truncated...] , as well as titles, sources, verified dates, retrieval locators, hashes, and exclusions.

blocks.en: The artifact publishes the exact number and date-exclusion regexes, scale dictionary, unit handling, and matching rule: remove comma, ASCII space, and non-breaking space; apply thousand/million/billion/lakh/crore scales; keep percentages separate; deduplicate within documents; drop recognised dates and bare years 1900–2100; and match (unit, round(value,6)) exactly with no tolerance. It pins rouge-score==0.1.2 with RougeScorer([’rougeL’], use_stemmer=True) and maximum-F1 multi-reference selection; bert-score==0.3.13 , roberta-large revision 722cf37b , English, no baseline rescaling, and multi-reference maximum; and sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 revision 1110a243 , normalised embeddings, average-linkage precomputed cosine distance, and threshold .35. The full revisions, tokenisation, packages, runtime, and 76,484-row non-text HumAID ID/hash manifest are machine-readable.
blocks.zh: 该文物公布确切的数字和排除日期的正则、缩放词典、单位处理和匹配规则:删除逗号、ASCII空间和不可拆解的空间;适用千/百万/亿/拉赫/立方公尺;保持百分比分开;在文件内复制;放弃确认的日期和光年1900-2100;完全不容许匹配(单位、圆(值6))。 它用RougeScomer([’rogeL],使用_stemmer=True])和最高-F1多参考选择来标注rouge-score=0.1.2;bert-score=0.3.13,roberta大修订 722cf37b,英语,没有基线缩放,和多参考最大;和句子- transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2修订 1110a243,正常嵌入,平均链接预算的cosine距离,和阈值 35。 全套修改、标识、包件、运行时间和76 484行非文本HumAID ID/hash 运单可以机器读取。

blocks.en: Public machine-output text is deliberately omitted after a spot check found that generations can repeat phone numbers and email addresses from crisis posts. Each of 264 outputs instead has a request hash, output hash, call time, and public model ID; licensed HumAID records have IDs and text hashes. Thus the released numerical tables and measurement functions are bit-for-bit auditable, and acquired inputs can be hash-verified, but fresh generation from mutable aliases is not promised to be deterministic. This is a privacy and provider-version boundary, not an unreported omission.
blocks.zh: 公用机器输出文本被故意省略, 264个产出中,每个产出都有一个请求散列、输出散列、呼叫时间和公开型号ID;有执照的HumAID记录有ID和文本散列。 因此,所发布的数值表和测量函数是比特值可审计的,所获取的投入可以散列验证,但来自可变别名的新生代并不承诺具有决定性. 这是一个隐私和提供者-版本边界,而不是未报告的遗漏。

blocks.en: Four silent implementation defects were found and corrected. First, the DeepSeek client sent max_completion_tokens , which that endpoint ignored; 75% of 3,532 calls exceeded the configured cap. Second, hyphenated ReliefWeb keys and underscored HumAID keys prevented reference pairing; canonical normalisation repaired it. Third, a 32,000-token generation probe truncated 25% of schema-guided versus 8% of generic Irma map calls; the reported replication uses 48,000, leaving 1.0% truncation overall and 0.0% for schema-guided Irma. Fourth, reference-metric CSVs recorded the default judge alias even when --judge-model judge_gemini was passed. Request logs establish google/gemini-3.7-flash ; labels and code are corrected, with no numeric score changed. Regression tests cover all four repairs.
blocks.zh: 发现并纠正了4个无声执行缺陷。 首先, DeepSeek 客户端发送了 max_ complete_tokens , 而该端点忽略了该端点;3,532个呼叫中有75%超过配置的上限 。 第二,连字符的 ReliefWeb 键和强调的 HumAID 键阻止了引用对等;canonical commonization修复了它. 第三,一个3.2万托肯的生成探测器截断了25%的图谱制导,而通用的伊尔玛地图调用率为8%;报告的复制使用4.8万台,总体截断率为1.0%,图谱制导的伊尔玛为0.0 %. 第四,参照度量衡的CSV记录了默认裁判员的别名,即使在-judge-model judge_gemini通过时. 请求日志建立google/gemini-3.7-flash;标签和代码被更正,没有改变数字分数. 后退试验涵盖全部4次维修.
